nodes.description: OwnableUpgradeable._owner - address holding owner privileges, gates onlyOwner functions
PausableUpgradeable._paused - flag controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers
Initializable._initialized - one-time initializer guard flag
ERC20Upgradeable._balances mapping of account balances
ERC20Upgradeable._allowances nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount
ERC20Upgradeable._totalSupply - total token supply
Remocoin.initialize - initializer that sets name/symbol/owner and mints 1e12 * 10**decimals to msg.sender
Remocoin.pause - onlyOwner, sets paused state true
Remocoin.unpause - onlyOwner, sets paused state false
Remocoin.mint - onlyOwner external mint that calls _mint(to, amount)
Remocoin._beforeTokenTransfer - whenNotPaused hook invoked on every mint/transfer/burn
Remocoin._authorizeUpgrade - onlyOwner guard over the UUPS upgrade mechanism
UUPSUpgradeable.upgradeTo - external upgrade entry point calling _authorizeUpgrade then delegatecall-based upgrade
UUPSUpgradeable.upgradeToAndCall - payable upgrade plus arbitrary delegatecall payload
ERC20Upgradeable._mint - increases _totalSupply and _balances, invokes _beforeTokenTransfer hook
ERC20Upgradeable._transfer - moves balances, invokes _beforeTokenTransfer hook
ERC20Upgradeable.transfer - public transfer of caller tokens
ERC20Upgradeable.transferFrom - allowance based transfer, updates allowance under unchecked block
ERC1967UpgradeUpgradeable._functionDelegateCall - performs raw delegatecall to target with data
ContextUpgradeable._msgSender - returns msg.sender
msg.sender - externally controlled caller, receives initial mint and is checked by onlyOwner
target.delegatecall(data) - executes arbitrary code in proxy storage context from user supplied implementation/data
unchecked currentAllowance - amount subtraction in transferFrom / decreaseAllowance
_totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount arithmetic in _mint
address to - mint recipient in Remocoin.mint
uint256 amount - minted quantity in Remocoin.mint
address from - source of the token hook call
address to - destination of the token hook call
uint256 amount - hook transfer quantity
address account - mint beneficiary in _mint
uint256 amount - supply increase in _mint
address newImplementation - user supplied implementation address for upgradeTo
bytes data - user supplied delegatecall payload
address newImplementation - argument validated by _authorizeUpgrade
address sender - debited account in _transfer
address recipient - credited account in _transfer
uint256 amount - moved value in _transfer
address recipient - transfer destination
uint256 amount - transfer value
address sender - allowance owner in transferFrom
address recipient - transferFrom destination
uint256 amount - transferFrom value
uint256 senderBalance - cached balance compared against amount in _transfer
uint256 currentAllowance - cached allowance reduced by amount
bool isTopLevelCall - flag deciding which initializer guard flags are written

initializer modifier writes the _initialized guard during initialize
Remocoin.mint delegates token creation to _mint
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances
transfer routes through the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom routes through the internal _transfer routine
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply and to the recipient balance
user supplied amount feeds the supply/balance addition in _mint
transferFrom subtracts amount from the allowance inside an unchecked block
currentAllowance is the operand of the unchecked subtraction

upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before any upgrade takes place

newImplementation argument is validated by _authorizeUpgrade
user supplied implementation address flows into the access controlled upgrade guard
data argument is forwarded to the delegatecall payload of upgradeToAndCall
whenNotPaused on _beforeTokenTransfer reads the _paused state variable
pause writes the _paused state variable to true
unpause writes the _paused state variable to false

amount parameter is passed into the token transfer hook
